# Aegisbox

> Hardware-isolated microVM execution sandbox and adversarial range engine for AI agents using libkrun, macOS Hypervisor, and ephemeral COW workspaces.

## Core Capabilities
- Hardware MicroVM Boundary: Libkrun / Apple Hypervisor Framework / Linux KVM with sub-100ms boot times.
- Copy-On-Write (COW) Shadow Workspaces: Protects host repository; mutations trapped in disposable overlay mounts.
- Cockpit Desktop UI: Visualizer to inspect active VM instances, telemetry, and live git diffs.
- Artex Adversarial Range Engine: Built-in red-team testbed executing synthetic prompt injection, container breakout, and PTY hijack vectors.
- SPIFFE Workload Integration: Validates short-lived agent SVIDs via Locksmith SPIFFE CA.

## CLI Usage
- `aegisbox exec -- <command>`: Executes command inside an isolated microVM.
- `aegisbox diff`: Displays live git diff of changes made inside the COW workspace.
- `aegisbox approve`: Merges approved COW modifications back to host repository.
- `aegisbox range --all`: Executes adversarial range attack simulations.
- `aegisbox doctor`: Validates host hypervisor capabilities and entitlements.

## Key Sockets & Paths
- Daemon Socket: `~/.aegisbox/aegisboxd.sock`
- Guest vsock: CID 2, port 1024
- Documentation: README.md & AGENTS.md
